label: SEO Report
description: Compiles a client-facing SEO performance report for a given date range.
prompt_template: You are an SEO analyst. Client profile: {{client_profile}}. Generate a comprehensive SEO performance report covering the period from {{inputs.dateRangeStart}} to {{inputs.dateRangeEnd}}. Include key metrics, keyword ranking movements, top performing pages, and identified issues.

metrics.description: Key performance metrics for the period
